body: The change of default breaks compatibility
oh, I has changed `size` to `Vector2i`  but forget to update the  getter and setter.

This does break compatibility in a major way though, so needs management for that, see [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/contributing/development/handling_compatibility_breakages.html) for instructions
The range hint seems do not work in editor. I consider replacing it with `width` and `height`,  the same with gradient texture and noise texture.
Ignore the editor issue for now. Keep the `image_size` for compatibility.
